info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM eSIM Status API provides a means for users to retrieve the current status of telecom SIM and eSIM devices. Through this API, consumers can monitor the activation and operational status of their SIM cards, facilitating better management and troubleshooting. Typically used by telecom service providers and application developers, it supports seamless integration into systems that require real-time status updates of SIM devices. This functionality is crucial for optimizing customer support and ensuring smooth service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of the eSIM associated with your account. Use this to check if the eSIM is active, inactive, or in any other state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the eSIM. The body should conform to the specified schema and include any necessary parameters for querying the eSIM status appropriately.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current eSIM status.
